acceptanceCriteria.text: `docs/ci-topology.md` exists and identifies #764 as its architecture authority.
PR, `main`, release, and #261 certification responsibilities are explicitly separated.
The contract ownership/path invalidation matrix covers governance, Node/static, product/integration, package, host-bootstrap, Nix Runtime, VM, Appliance, and publication.
The document explicitly rejects blanket `host-bootstrap/** -> full Nix/VM/Appliance` invalidation.
The document states when an Appliance-defining PR must build/verify the canonical Appliance and when full cross-boundary Appliance golden-path certification runs on `main`.
A #763 worked example states the targeted checks that should and should not execute.
Required-check determinism, cache correctness semantics, concurrency invariants, and latency SLOs are documented.
Current workflow behavior that intentionally differs from the target is clearly labeled as migration debt rather than described as the intended architecture.
No workflow behavior or product code is changed in this PR.
Documentation is sufficiently concrete for follow-up Issues to reference individual ownership classes and tier boundaries without re-specifying them.

issue.title: docs(ci): document the contract-owned CI topology
